records.name: Vern Checkpoint
records.biography_en: Vern Checkpoint serves with Checkpoint Crew, a paramilitary response detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The olive cap is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Vern Checkpoint looks improbably official even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
